goal: Complete Any Order Pick3/4/5 digit-multiset prediction before each official wager cutoff; any lawful, accessible pre-draw variable is eligible, not only historical winners.
scope: Virginia Lottery official Pick3/4/5 day/night drawings
verified_procedural_facts: Lottery's published Drawing Security page says officials randomly select ball sets and drawing machines approximately two hours before a draw.
The same page says officials conduct equipment tests and pretest drawings.
Drawing master control forms include equipment used, pretest numbers drawn, official numbers drawn and time betting was closed.
Public lottery site publishes historical official winning numbers. The published security page does not provide an authenticated, timestamped, pre-cutoff machine/pretest feed.

candidate_sources.name: Selected drawing machine identifier
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Some equipment may have stable, measurable differential digit frequencies or mechanical effects.
prerequisites: archive of machine IDs joined by draw/position
enough draws per machine after selection

candidate_sources.name: Selected ball set identifier and position
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Ball-set tolerances might create small systematic differences; this remains hypothetical.
prerequisites: correct mapping to positions and games

candidate_sources.name: Pretest digits and pretest failure records
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Equipment-specific pretest evidence might update a mechanical-bias prior if shared equipment actually persists.
prerequisites: number of pretests and ordered results
whether each pretest changes ball state

candidate_sources.name: Official draw video (machine/ball configuration)
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Archived recordings could classify prior equipment regimes for research, but cannot alone provide this draw's future outcome.
prerequisites: must not infer future setup from post-draw video

candidate_sources.name: Draw schedule, weekday, day/night, rule/equipment changes
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Observable structural regime markers might change equipment allocation, not automatically winning-digit probabilities.

candidate_sources.name: Ambient weather
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Outdoor weather should not be assumed to affect controlled indoor equipment without documented mechanism and on-site conditions.

candidate_sources.name: Sales volume, number popularity, retailer patterns
candidate_sources.physical_hypothesis: Purchasers' choices do not change randomly drawn digits; could affect payout sharing or decision economics, not primary winner probability.

pre_draw_feature_contract.invariant: Both source_published_at_utc and source_observed_at_utc must be strictly earlier than wager_close_utc; features missing proof of public availability are excluded, never backfilled into pre-draw forecasts.
validations: no result field from target or later
reject machine/pretest identifiers published only after ticket cutoff
no hindsight labels smuggled via timestamps
audit time of first availability, not merely data's event date
missing source = missing feature; no fabricated values

next_action: Find a public, timestamp-verifiable machine/ball-set/pretest source available before cutoff. Do not build a prediction formula assuming such access. Independently distinguish a record that existed internally from information publicly available at wagering time.
current_status: No confirmed exogenous equipment or pretest variable is presently connected to VAL's live prediction inputs; no claim of real predictive advantage.
